name: Odaiji ni
source:
Fall in love with the cuteness of Sanji-kun from ONE PIECE in this mostly novel, not-really-gamey visual novel game. Focused on Sanji x Nami.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE137440.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在这款以新颖、不那么游戏性为主的视觉小说游戏中，爱上海贼王中山治君的可爱。专注于山治×娜美。

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE137440.html]DLsite English[/url]]
